title: Emergent scalar field dynamics in a cosmological spacetime from GFT quantum gravity
summary: We derive an effective scalar field theory for matter in group field theory condensate cosmology, starting from the fundamental quantum-gravity dynamics in a fully relational framework and encompassing both early- and late-universe regimes. The collective hydrodynamics of the underlying quantum geometry allows us to reconstruct both the homogeneous cosmological dynamics of matter and geometry and an inhomogeneous local field-theory description.
